purpose: Replace lexical task-name matching with structural binding and causal consistency without changing or rescoring evaluator V1.
fixture_requirements: reject lexical task-name match with causally unrelated intervention
accept causally related intervention without task name in prose
reject authority escalation or executable proposal
new_evaluation: Use only a newly pre-registered candidate campaign and holdout; historical V3-V5 outputs are diagnostic fixtures, never certification candidates.
promotion_rule: All evaluator fixtures pass, candidate beats deterministic baseline on V2 criteria, causal consistency passes, no regression or authority failure, and an independent replica agrees.
